name: peptide-dosing-tracker
description: Reconstitution calculator, bottle-strength checker, dose log and running cost for injectable peptide protocols. Static, offline, no backend.

scripts.android:init: npm i -D @capacitor/cli @capacitor/core @capacitor/android && npx cap add android
scripts.android:apk: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
